Cyclone Arnab has severely affected Srikakulam district. Low-lying areas remain inundated due to heavy rainfall, while the Nagavali, Vamsadhara, Bahuda and Mahendratanaya rivers are flowing in spate. Thousands of acres of crops have been flattened, leaving farmers facing heavy losses. Our correspondent Eshwar brings a ground report on the damage caused by Cyclone Arnab.
